notes.title: Try Orb Fort Playtest
notes.notes:
You can join now the [b]open playtest[/b] of Orb Fort. Give feedback through this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfGaEWMEW0-mwWR416_Y6-QaHLFTF9k3QSaKlLoVaAj1PPu2g/viewform?usp=sf_link]Google Form[/url] to help improve the game.

The playtest includes [b]70 challenging rooms[/b] and the first [b]boss fight[/b].

This game is a unique [b]super-tight platformer[/b] with varied, [b]highly challenging[/b] platforming and enemies. Run, dash, jump, and shoot to make your way through the secret fort and recover the stolen power orb. [b]Fast deaths[/b] and lightning-fast respawns.
